taste-candidate.context: Candidate guidance: infer the surface and audience, set design variance, motion intensity and visual density, avoid generic AI defaults, use a real design system when appropriate, preserve incumbent structure on redesign, and run a strict pre-flight. The upstream candidate also contains fixed AIDA, GSAP, dark-mode, image-generation and quota rules; do not treat those as local policy.

impeccable-candidate.context: Candidate guidance: distinguish brand, product, reading and experience surfaces; ground work in product/design context; avoid generic AI patterns; inspect desktop and mobile together; fix findings in one batch and confirm once. Do not install its commands, context files, detector or hooks in this evaluation.
